prompt:
Generate a single 1536x1024 landscape image: a flat, screenshot-like UI mockup of one web app screen. The screen is the signed-in /brief page of a product called Pemby, at desktop width.

STRUCTURE — one wide today surface, then full-width rows:
1. A slim top row, about 5% of the height, transparent on the sand ground: the wordmark 'Pemby' small at the left, five quiet text destinations across the middle with 'Brief' in heavier ink and the rest in warm grey, and a small circular theme toggle at the far right. No bar fill, no border beneath.
2. A single wide raised near-white 'today' surface spanning about 88% of the frame width, centred, roughly 26% of the frame height, with 18px radius and a soft two-layer warm shadow, generously padded at about 40px. Inside it, at the left, the statement 'Three roles can hire you from Moldova today.' set large at about 40px medium weight in warm near-black, taking two lines, with the context line beneath it in warm grey at about 14px. At the right of the same surface, a quiet vertical group: the numeral 3 very large in tabular figures with the small warm-grey label 'matches today' beneath it, and under that, smaller, the numeral 6 with the label 'near misses'. A single hairline separates the left and right halves. This surface is the focal moment of the whole screen.
3. Beneath it, generous space, then three full-width match rows spanning the same 88% width, each its own raised near-white surface with 18px radius and a soft shadow, separated by 16px gaps, each about 14% of the frame height and generously padded at about 26px. Each row is laid out horizontally in four zones: at the left, the company name in medium ink at about 20px with the role title in warm grey at about 15px beneath it; next to it the tier pill with its marker disc and its word; then in the widest middle zone the three reasons set as three short plain sentences separated by thin vertical hairlines, in ink at about 14px, with the gap line beneath them in warm grey; then at the right the score in tabular figures at about 30px with a small 'SCORE' label above it; and at the far right the action group, the pine 'Apply' button with 12px radius above the two quiet text buttons 'Save' and 'Not for me'.
4. Below the third row, a quieter full-width near-miss strip, less lifted than the match rows, carrying 'Near misses' in medium weight at the left and the three grouped counts laid out horizontally across it, each count in tabular figures with its blocker in warm grey.
5. A footer line on the bare sand ground carrying the permanent tier legend as one horizontal row of the three tier pills at the left, and 'EXAMPLE — SYNTHETIC DATA' very small at the right.
The focal moment is the wide today surface; the rows beneath it are even, calm and repetitive.

WORLD — identical in every respect, this is a fixed design system:
Ground: warm sand #F7F3EC filling the whole frame. Raised surfaces: near-white #FFFDFA, 18px corner radius, lifted off the ground by a soft warm-tinted two-layer shadow (a wide soft ambient shadow plus a tight contact shadow). Surfaces have NO borders; a 1px warm hairline #E7E0D6 appears only where two surfaces genuinely meet or where a list divides internally.
Ink: warm near-black #1C1A17 for primary text, warm grey #6B6560 for secondary text and labels.
Exactly ONE accent colour: pine #1F6B4F. It is used only for the single primary action on each surface and for focus rings. Nothing else in the entire image is pine. There is no second accent.
Eligibility tier is never carried by colour alone. Each tier is a small marker shape plus its word plus a desaturated tint pill: a FILLED disc with "Hires from your country" on sage #E8F0E4 with the mark and text in #3E6B35; a HALF-filled disc with "Likely" on honey #F7EEDC with the mark and text in #99702A; a HOLLOW disc with "Unclear" on stone #F1EEE9 with the mark and text in #6B6560.
Type: ONE typeface throughout, a warm humanist grotesk with open apertures and slightly rounded terminals, in the character of Hanken Grotesk. Hierarchy comes only from size, weight and ink colour. Scores are set in tabular lining figures, medium weight, never oversized. There is no monospace anywhere in the image and no serif anywhere in the image.
Controls: 12px radius, quiet and low-contrast at rest; chips and tier pills are full rounded pills. Buttons are text-and-shape, never icon-only except where stated.
Feeling: this is warm, generous, tactile, native-feeling software in the spirit of Things, Craft and Bear. Calm, spacious, confident. It is NOT a web dashboard, NOT a print or editorial layout, NOT a themed or metaphorical world.

CONTENT — render exactly these words:
Product name: Pemby
The statement: "Three roles can hire you from Moldova today."
Context line: "Sunday 21 September · checked against Moldova · every role verified on the company's own board within 12 hours"
Match 1 — Hallow Systems / Senior Frontend Engineer / score 92 / tier "Hires from your country" / reasons: "B2B contractor listed", "TypeScript and React match", "6h time zone overlap" / "Gap — no Next.js in your CV"
Match 2 — Verdant Grid / Staff Software Engineer / score 88 / tier "Hires from your country" / reasons: "EOR named in the posting", "7 years meets the 5+ ask", "salary band published" / "Gap — Kubernetes asked, not in your CV"
Match 3 — Marlow & Quinn / Frontend Engineer / score 84 / tier "Likely" / reasons: "Contractors in Eastern Europe on the team page", "React 19 match" / "Gap — no public country list"
Actions on each match: "Apply" as the single pine primary button, then "Save" and "Not for me" as quiet secondary actions.
Near misses block: "Near misses" with three grouped rows — "3 blocked by country (US only)", "2 blocked by way of working (employee only)", "1 closed since yesterday".
A permanent tier legend showing all three tiers with their markers and words.
Small and unobtrusive: "EXAMPLE — SYNTHETIC DATA"

FORBIDDEN: no breadcrumb, no page-header bar with a title and filter control, no badge soup, no indigo, no blue, no purple, no gradient of any kind, no glassmorphism, no blur, no illustration, no photography, no logos, no avatars, no icons beyond tiny functional chevrons and the tier discs, no ratings, no star icons, no counts of users or jobs, no testimonials, no lorem ipsum, no invented extra text. No device frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no desk, no perspective, no tilt, no drop shadow around the whole screen. The image IS the screen, edge to edge. All text crisp, correctly spelled and legible exactly as written.
